messages.author: b67d3156791014b7
messages.subject: Right truncated Possion likelihood
parts:
Hi,
 Is there any way I can specify a right-truncated Poisson likelihood in inla. 
e.g. Y ~ Poisson (lambda), but I want to specify F(Y| Y<=c) ~ Poisson(lambda)/Pr(Y<=c| lambda)

Thanks,
Anirban

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Right truncated Possion likelihood
